content: Yoosefanne Phoxfaara Machiw
Isma7eela asati Yoosefa Gibxe biitta efidosona. Gibxe kawa moorinatape issuwas, kawa naageysata halaqaas Yoosefa bayzidosona.
Goday Yoosefara de7iya gisho, I oothiyaba ubbaa iyaw injeyis. Yaatin, ba Gibxe godaa son de7is.
Goday iyara de7eysanne I oothiyaba ubbaa iyaw injeyidaysa Phoxfaari be7ida wode,
Yoosefa dosis, baw mata oosancho oothis. Phoxfaari iya ba keetha bollanne baw de7iyaba ubbaa bolla shuumis.
He wodepe doomidi, Goday Gibxe ura keetha Yoosefa gisho anjis. Godaa anjoy Phoxfaara sooninne iya gaden de7iyaba ubbaa bolla wodhis.
I miya kathiw eriyaripe attishin, baw de7iya haraba ubbaa Yoosefa kushen sheedhis. Yoosefi yegelsinne mala lo77o asi.
Guutha wodepe guye, iya godaa machiya Yoosefa be7ada, “Haaya, taara zin7a” yaagasu.
Shin I ixidi, iiko, “Be7a, ta goday, baw de7iyaba ubbaa ta kushen yeggida gisho, ba son de7iyabas aykoka hirgenna.
Ha son taape aadhey oonika baawa. Neeni iya macho gidiya gisho, neepe attishin, haraa, I taw immonabay baawa. Yaatin, taani waatada haysa mela daro iitaba hanada Xoossa bolla nagara ootho?” yaagis.
Iya he odaa wonta wonta Yoosefas odinka, I iira aqonna woyko I mata shiiqona ixis.
Shin issi gallas I ba ooso oothanaw soo geliya wode, soo aylletape oonika son baawa.
Iya Yoosefa afila oykada, “Taara zin7a” yaagasu. Shin I ba afila I kushiyan yeggi aggidi, soope kare woxi keyis.
Yoosefi ba afila I kushiyan yeggi aggidi, soope kare woxi keydaysa iya be7ida wode,
ba soo aylleta xeegada, “Heko, ta azinay ehida ha Ibraawe uray tana kawushshanaw oykis. I tana iissanaw ta de7iyasuwa gelis, shin taani waassas.
I ba afila ta matan yeggi aggidi, soope kare woxidi keyis” yaagasu.
I azinay soo yaana gakanaw iya Yoosefa afila ba matan wothasu.
I yin, iyaw haysada gada odasu; “Haysi ne ehida Ibraawe aylley tana iissanaw taako gelis.
Shin taani waassin, ba afila ta matan yeggi aggidi, soope kare woxi keyis” yaagasu.
Iya goday hanidaba si7ida wode daro yilotis.
Iya goday Yoosefa efidi, kawa qasho asay de7iya qasho keethan yeggis.
Shin Yoosefi qasho keethan de7iya wode, Goday iyara de7ees. Ba keehatetha iyaw darsidi, qasho keetha kaapuwa sinthan iyaw saba immis.
Yaanin, qasho keetha kaapoy qasho asa ubba Yoosefa kushen yeggis. Yan oosetiyaba ubbaas aawatetha immis.
Goday Yoosefara gididi, I oothiyaba ubbaa iyaw injeyida gisho, qasho keethaa kaapoy Yoosefa kushen de7iyabas aykoka hirgenna.
